summary: Tested Grupo Consolidado feature for AURION Sistema Fiscal. Fixed critical bug in GrupoConsolidado.js where user/onLogout props were not passed to Layout component. All backend endpoints pass (6/6). Frontend functionality verified: menu appears only for matriz companies, all 6 tabs work correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.js correctly checks if company is matriz via /api/empresa/{company_id}/grupo-info endpoint
Menu 'Grupo Consolidado' appears in IMPOSTOS section only when isMatriz is true
GrupoConsolidado.js component now correctly receives and passes user/onLogout props to Layout
Backend endpoints grupo-info and impostos-grupo return correct consolidated data for matriz + filiais
seed_data_creation: None - used existing Grupo Comercial RS with 1 matriz + 1 filial
context_for_next_testing_agent: Grupo Consolidado feature is fully functional. The group 'Grupo Comercial RS' contains COMERCIAL RS LTDA (matriz, code 6026) and TEKNOLINK SJC (filial). Menu appears correctly only when matriz company is selected. All 6 tabs (Indicadores, ICMS, PIS/COFINS, IRPJ/CSLL, RET, Reforma Tributária) work correctly.

menu_visibility_for_matriz.details: Menu 'Grupo Consolidado' with 'GRUPO' badge appears in IMPOSTOS section only when COMERCIAL RS LTDA (matriz) is selected

grupo_info_endpoint.details: GET /api/empresa/{company_id}/grupo-info returns correct is_matriz, grupo, matriz, filiais data

impostos_grupo_endpoint.details: GET /api/empresa/{company_id}/impostos-grupo returns consolidated data for matriz + filiais with competencia parameter

page_loading.details: /grupo-consolidado page loads correctly with header, tabs, and consolidated data

tabs_functionality.details: All 6 tabs (Indicadores, ICMS, PIS/COFINS, IRPJ/CSLL, RET, Reforma Tributária) navigate correctly and show appropriate data

consolidated_display.details: Page displays MATRIZ card, FILIAL cards, and CONSOLIDADO DO GRUPO summary with correct styling

bug_fixed.description: GrupoConsolidado.js was not passing user and onLogout props to Layout component, causing 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading name)' error
bug_fixed.root_cause: Component signature was missing props from router
bug_fixed.fix_applied: Added { user, onLogout } props to component and passed them to all Layout instances
